integrity: Self-contained derivation and runnable high-precision diagnostic; no claim of external checking or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Small-propulsion coefficient only in a fully absorbing disk with translational diffusion; initial angular average at a fixed radius. The high-turning boundary layer is an iterated derivative/limit, not a uniform two-parameter expansion. The linear Bessel correction is prior work. Hidden equivalent computations and broad propagation formulas remain originality risks.
title: Orientationally averaged escape in an active Brownian disk: exact quadratic response and a fast-turning boundary layer
